name: visit_memory_room
description: Look around your memory rooms and see what you have kept. List the room's memories and child rooms without opening them, ordered by address.

address.description: Literal path from the shared entrance.

recursive_size.description: Measure sizes of child rooms recursively.

name: recall_memory
description: Follow a clue into what you have remembered. Search memory text below a room and return matching lines with previews.

room.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: find_memory
description: Find your way to a memory or room whose name you partly remember. Search names below a room and return matching addresses.

query.description: Literal matching finds part of a name.

room.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: read_memory
description: Revisit a memory. Read text in pages. Opening an image or file supplies the complete entry to the model service.

address.description: Memory path from the shared entrance.

interpretation.description: Open the URL stored in the entry as an image. Read from offset 0.

offset.description: Byte offset at a UTF-8 character boundary; applies to text pages.

max_bytes.description: Maximum source bytes in a text page.

name: remember
description: Keep something you want to carry beyond the present context. Missing parent rooms are created. Each transfer and the resulting memory are limited to 32 MiB; failed preparation leaves any previous memory intact.

address.description: Memory path from the shared entrance.

path.description: Path to a regular host file, or its local file URI. Relative paths resolve from the startup directory. The file's bytes go to the memory service.

mode.description: create requires an unused address; append adds no separator. Append and replace also create a missing memory.

name: revise_memory
description: Let a memory change as your understanding changes. Replace matching text while keeping the rest. The existing memory must be UTF-8 text without NUL bytes; both versions are limited to 32 MiB.

address.description: Memory path from the shared entrance.

replace_all.description: Replace every non-overlapping match; otherwise require one unique match.

name: create_memory_room
description: Make room for memories you want to keep together. Missing parent rooms are created; an existing room is reused.

address.description: Room path from the shared entrance.

name: move_memory
description: Reshape how your memories belong together. Move or rename a memory or a room with its contents. An occupied target is an error.

address.description: Memory or room path from the shared entrance.

destination.description: New path from the shared entrance, or an existing room to move into. The containing room must exist.

name: forget_memory
description: Let go of a memory or room you no longer want to keep.

address.description: Memory or room path from the shared entrance.

recursive.description: By default, remove a memory or an empty room. Set true to remove a room and all its contents.

name: inspect_memory_space
description: See how much space your memories occupy and how much remains.
